status: compiler root cause identified; corrected hardware run pending
root_cause: encodeBatchedMatmul constructs runtime input layouts from post-transpose geometry even when the task stream begins with a transpose prefix. Dense original K is therefore padded at the wrong row and plane boundaries.

cpu_reproduction.method: Pack original K using the bad manifest (128 rows of 375 fp16 elements, 768-byte row, 98304-byte plane). Interpret those bytes as the original input surface (375 rows of 128 fp16 elements, 256-byte row, 96000-byte plane). Compute captured Q times reconstructed K transpose in float32 and round to fp16. Compare against saved device scores. No device execution.
cpu_reproduction.interpretation: The wrong packing reproduces the large error; residual arithmetic rounding is not established as bit-parity.

test_gap: Batched CLI suite skipped all nine one-prefix captures because its accepted task-count remainders were 0 and 25, not 0 and 1. It also did not compare input layout metadata to Apple tensor descriptors. Inspector rejected valid one-prefix programs.
fix_scope: Original X and runtime Y geometry selected using transpose flags in shared encodeBatchedMatmul. Input metadata checked against every successful captured oracle. Inspector ties task count to actual output batch with zero or one prefix.
failing_first: New descriptor comparison failed on transpose-X constant-weight capture: emitted [1,8,375,128,96000,256], expected [1,8,128,375,98304,768].
fixed_test: python3 tests/test_h13_batched_cli.py build/mil-hwxc: PASS after rebuilding compiler
qualification: No full encoder, performance, M2, or release acceptance claim. Baseline select exact; baseline add and softmax retain own small rounding differences.
